name: hacknation-misja-aed
description: Convenience scripts: the Django backend lives in backend/ (uv), the Next.js frontend in frontend/ (its own package.json and lockfile)

scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd .. && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db: docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python manage.py seed
scripts.sync: cd backend && uv run python manage.py sync
scripts.manage: cd backend && uv run python manage.py
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
